Read the device object's vtable pointer v4 from the global dword_8B89A0 and select the slot at v4 + 244.
Build the parameter value: when a2 is non-null, dereference the object pointer at a2 + 84 and read the dword at offset +20 of that inner object; when a2 is null, use 0.
Dispatch the __stdcall virtual method at vtable slot +244 on dword_8B89A0 with (dword_8B89A0, *this, parameter value), using the object identifier from this+0x0 as the second argument.
After a successful non-null dispatch store a2 into this[12] (this+0x30); in the null branch store 0 into this+0x30.
Return the virtual dispatch result, or the unchanged stored pointer this+0x30 when the guard skipped the dispatch.
